newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Lower Danish March trade surplus foreseen.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Lower Danish March trade surplus foreseen.

text.p: Eleven analysts polled by Reuters in a survey issued on Monday foresaw Denmark's March foreign trade surplus excluding ships falling to an average 3.0 billion crowns from February's 3.1 billion crown surplus.
"The foreign trade surplus is expected to be negatively affected by the fact that Easter fell in March this year," one analyst said.
There was a wide divergence in the forecasts, which ranged from surpluses of 1.5 billion crowns to 4.5 billion crowns.
The panel predicted that Denmark's March current account would swing into an average deficit of 0.6 billion crowns from the previous month's 2.9 billion crown surplus.
The current account estimates were in the minus 3.4-plus 1.1 billion crown range.
The Danish national statistics office releases the March foreign trade and current account data on Wednesday June 4 at 0730 GMT.
